title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child counts the mishororo of an ubeti to name the kind (2 tathnia, 3 tathlitha, 4 tarbia), finds ukwapi and utao, and reads the poem for its message.
steps: Count the lines in one ubeti.

board.say: Shairi hili ni la aina gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child names three stanzas and marks ukwapi and utao in one line.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ubeti wenye mishororo miwili huitwa ___." Kwa nini "tathlitha" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tathnia ni mishororo miwili, tathlitha mitatu na tarbia minne. Jina linaonyesha idadi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ubeti huu ni wa aina gani? "Mvua imenyesha, / Mito imejaa."" Kwa nini "tathlitha" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hesabu mishororo kwanza. Mistari miwili ni tathnia, mitatu ni tathlitha, minne ni tarbia.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." Kwa nini "utao" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mshororo hugawanyika katika sehemu mbili: ukwapi ni ya kwanza, utao ni ya pili.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kipande cha pili cha mshororo wa shairi huitwa ___." Kwa nini "vina" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, na mizani ni silabi. Vipande vya mshororo ni ukwapi na utao.

checks.question: Kipande cha kwanza cha mshororo huitwa?
